name: Caltech Summer Undergraduate Research Fellowships (SURF)
dlText: 22 Feb 2027 (one official page says 1 Mar; time not stated)
tags: Must find a Caltech faculty mentor
fields: Science, engineering, mathematics and other Caltech disciplines
note: Visiting undergraduates from any country can do SURF on the Caltech campus if a Caltech faculty member agrees to mentor them; SURF@JPL is US-only. The 2027 application opens 1 Nov 2026; official pages give 22 Feb or 1 Mar, so check.

name: LIGO SURF (Caltech)
host: LIGO Laboratory, California Institute of Technology
dlText: ~11 Jan 2027, estimated from 2026 cycle (time not stated)

eligibility.note: Undergraduates from all institutions, US and foreign; some funding is restricted to US citizens/PRs, but several international students are taken each year

fields: Physics, astronomy, engineering, computing related to gravitational-wave detection
note: 10-week summer research at LIGO/Caltech. The 2026 window ran 7 Nov 2025 to 11 Jan 2026, so expect a similar window for 2027.

name: CSHL Undergraduate Research Program (URP)
dlText: 15 Jan 2027, 23:59 PST (year not stated on page)

eligibility.note: Page says students of any nationality are eligible, but another section limits foreign students to those at US universities or partner foreign universities; confirm with URP office

fields: Biological sciences, neuroscience, genomics, quantitative biology
note: Summer research at Cold Spring Harbor with stipend, room and board covered. Recommendation letters must also arrive by the deadline.

name: Chemers Neustein Summer Undergraduate Research Fellowship (SURF)
note: 10-week lab research in New York City. Free housing for students who cannot commute.

name: WHOI Summer Student Fellowship
amount: US$721/week (2026 rate) for 10–12 weeks + travel up to US$720
dlText: ~1 Feb 2027, estimated from 2026 cycle (time not stated)
fields: Ocean sciences, marine biology, geology, chemistry, physics, engineering
note: Paid summer research at Woods Hole. International fellows have 14% US federal tax deducted from the stipend, travel allowance and housing value.

name: Vector Institute AI Research Internships
dlText: Summer term applications usually Nov–Jan (exact date not stated)
tags: Enrolled at a university in Canada or abroad

eligibility.note: Students at universities in Canada or abroad; excludes residents of countries under Canadian technical-assistance prohibitions or flagged as cyber threats, and people linked to Named Research Organizations

note: Paid research internship with Vector faculty in Toronto, funded through the Pan-Canadian AI Strategy. Interns from abroad usually use the 120-day researcher work-permit exemption.

name: ANU Future Research Talent Awards (India)
amount: A$8,500 travel and living award for 11–12 weeks
fields: Science, medicine, engineering, computing, law, governance and policy
note: 11–12 week research visit to ANU. Partner institutions run their own selection and nominate a few students; past recipients cannot apply again.

nominationBody: Your university or institution (ANU collaborating institution)
name: ANU Future Research Talent Awards (Indonesia)
amount: A$8,500 (airfare, visa, insurance, accommodation, living costs)
note: 10–12 week research visit to ANU for students or academic/government research staff. Eligible institutions change each intake.
